# 1 Enoch Chapter 97 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch — Woe Oracles

---

**1** Listen carefully: the children of humanity will be brought before the holy ones to swear the great oath. The holy ones will be fed. The sons of heaven will be their judges. They will stand and swear before them.

**2** In that day, gold will save no one. Silver will save no one. There will be no escape.

**3** There will be no iron left for war. No breastplate to put on. Bronze will be worthless. Tin will be worthless, thrown aside. Lead will have no value, no buyers.

**4** All these things — every weapon, every metal of war — will be swept away from the face of the earth when the Elect One steps forward before the Lord of Spirits.

**5** Woe to you who live for godlessness and brag about it — you who feast on your own souls, who eat the finest produce of the earth and call it righteousness.

**6** Here is what you should know: you will be handed over to the righteous. They will cut you down and show you no mercy.

**7** Woe to you who celebrate when righteous people suffer — no one will dig you a grave.

**8** Woe to those who dismiss the words of the righteous — you have forfeited any hope of life.

**9** Woe to those who put lies and godlessness into writing — they write their lies so others will read them and be led into wickedness against their neighbors.

**10** These people will find no peace. Their death will come fast.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Vv. 3–4 are one of the most striking passages in the Epistle — an eschatological demolition of the entire war economy. No iron, no bronze, no tin, no lead for weapons. This will happen specifically when the Elect One appears. V. 9 is extraordinary: a woe against bad writers, against those who corrupt through the written word. In a scribal tradition that prizes the book above all, this is a sharp edge.*
